answer.text: The manual says the number-plate light is part of an LED tail lamp, trafficator and license plate illuminator assembly.
If it fails, the manual says the entire assembly should be replaced.
Contact an authorised Royal Enfield Dealer or Service Centre to replace it.
The manual lists the license plate illuminator as 12 V LED.

policy.text: In the event of failure, the entire tail lamp/trafficator and license plate illuminator assembly should be replaced.
Replacement is carried out by an authorised Royal Enfield Dealer or Service Centre.

watchouts.text: Using bulbs or electrical gadgets with a rating other than the specified one will overload the electrical system, cause erratic behaviour and lead to premature failure.
Fitting parts not approved by Royal Enfield can seriously affect the vehicle's performance and will void the warranty.

disclaimers.text: These sections do not give a part number or name a specific bulb or assembly to buy.
The manual gives the license plate illuminator as 12 V LED but no part number or wattage.
